# Darija Meško | Thrive Through HR

> Darija Meško is an HR professional, recruiter, career coach and workshop facilitator with 12+ years of experience across different sectors and HR across Slovenia, Germany and the UAE (Dubai). Through Thrive Through HR she helps job seekers find work in Europe and the UAE, and helps companies hire the right people and build teams that communicate well. She works in English and Slovenian, live or online. The full site is also available in Slovenian at https://www.darijamesko.com/sl/.

Key facts:
- 1,000+ people hired or coached into new jobs, 10,000+ CVs reviewed, people of 30+ nationalities
- Former Head of People and Culture in the UAE and People and Culture Business Partner in Germany
- SPHRi certified, certified in Emotional Intelligence through Daniel Goleman Emotional Intelligence Courses (Key Step Media)
- Author of the book "From Jobless to Empowered, the UAE edition"
- Contact: darija@darijamesko.com

## For individuals
- [Career coaching, CV and LinkedIn services](https://www.darijamesko.com/individuals/): Consultation (50 EUR, 1:1 video call of about 60 minutes), Basic package (105 EUR, CV, LinkedIn and cover letter), Premium package (full career support), CV rewrite (60 EUR), LinkedIn rewrite (50 EUR), free CV, LinkedIn and cover letter review
- [Webinars](https://www.darijamesko.com/webinars/): live online webinar "How the hell do I get a job in Europe and/or the UAE?" (30 EUR)

## For companies
- [Companies overview](https://www.darijamesko.com/companies/)
- [Team workshops](https://www.darijamesko.com/companies/workshops/): communication, conflict (Glasl's 9 stages), DISC personality styles, emotional intelligence, CliftonStrengths and cross-cultural communication, for teams of up to 15 people, live or online. Packages Basic 1,600 EUR, Advanced 3,200 EUR, Premium 4,500 EUR
- [Recruiting](https://www.darijamesko.com/companies/recruiting/): hiring from intern to C-level across Europe, the UAE and the Middle East
